# The Native Journey

The same ideas as the Android chapters, on a small C program with actual
symbols: no ART, no classloaders, a license gate and a flag in memory.

| Chapter | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Building the target](building_the_target.qmd) | compile and run `native_demo` |
| [Attach and explore](attach_and_explore.qmd) | symbols instead of RegisterNatives |
| [Breaking on check](breaking_on_check.qmd) | breakpoint `check_key`, continue |
| [Patching and spawning](patching_and_spawning.qmd) | patch the key, spawn and launch |

On Android, native methods hide behind `RegisterNatives`. On the host, the
symbol table is visible directly.
